notes.title: Cool off with the Steam Summer Sale – get up to 90% off PQube Games!
notes.notes:
Ah, summer. Sundresses, ice cream…and, of course, some crazy discounts on games! With everything from pixel platformers to furr-tastic RPGs, there is something for everyone in the PQube catalogue. Check out some of our top picks below!

Gal*Gun Returns

PANTIES! Got your attention? It’s ok, your secret’s safe with us. Escape hordes of amorous schoolgirls in infamous ecchi rail-shooter Gal*Gun Returns – now 20% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425730/

Inertial Drift

Let off some steam (!) with this innovative twin-stick racing game, now at 33% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1184480/

Cat Quest II

Cats or dogs? Single player or co-op? No need to pick- we’ve got both in this wildly popular action-RPG! Now at 45% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/914710/

Songbird Symphony

Guide orphaned chick ‘Birb’ through a beautifully crafted pixel world in this rhythm-action platformer: now 55% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/909820/

Die After Sunset

OK, this one isn’t in the sale, but we think you’ll love it all the same. Battle for Earth and travel through time this newly announced 3rd person action roguelite. But be careful! You never know what’s lurking in the shadows…

Wishlist now to be the first to get updates on Die After Sunset, coming soon to Steam Early Access.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1440010/

notes.title: Songbird Symphony dances into stores
notes.notes:
In the great dogs-versus-cats debate, the correct answer is birds. And along comes Songbird Symphony, released this week, to feature our feathered friends front and centre for once. The music-based platformer follows Birb, an orphaned chick out to figure out just where he came from. Don t worry, he s very upbeat about the whole thing, look.

(more…)

notes.title: Chirp chirp! Songbird Symphony is now available on Steam, Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4!!
notes.notes:
This is it! Today is the big day. 

To celebrate the launch, Songbird Symphony is 10% off until the 1st of August!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33432476/d3e615ed284e92531ddf0a9d903f7bf993c3cd53.gif[/img]

Birb is a wholesome character (with wild dancing skills!), we truly hope you will enjoy your adventure with him as much as we did. Don't forget to join the discord server of the game and share your impressions with the developers and the community: https://discord.gg/64PVzb5

Check out also the launch trailer if you've missed it:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o3vmzG3kKbY&
PQube

notes.title: Songbird Symphony swooping onto Steam, Switch and PS4 on 25th July!
notes.notes:
Hey everybirdy~!

After working on the game for 2 years, we're happy to announce that you'll finally be able to play with Birb, Uncle Pea, and all their friends when Songbird Symphony finally comes out on Steam, Switch and PS4 in less than 2 weeks!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33432476/095cb866c2a33083b9b619030176b60dbdef7fb8.gif[/img]

We recently released a free demo right here on Steam, so don't forget to give it a shot! If you liked it, Birb would really appreciate it if you [b]add the game to your wishlists![/b]

And guess what? If you have a Switch too, and want to have Birb come along with you on adventures, the demo for the Switch version in the EU regions is out now! (The Switch US region demo will be up on 15th July.)

Check out this new Narrative trailer we just released :)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcShLsh-Sk8

For more updates and information, we'll be sharing much more stuff on our social medias leading up to launch day! 
https://twitter.com/SongbirdSymph
https://www.facebook.com/songbirdsymphony

Also, feel free to join our fan community on Discord!
https://discord.gg/64PVzb5

Thanks for all the support from our friends, family, and fans! It's been quite the journey.

May the music guide your wings!
Joysteak Studios

notes.title: Screenshot Saturday Sundays: Fox friends, festive flight, and fragment fishing
notes.notes:
E3 might be over, but the great turning wheel of game development never pauses. These developers might not get the glitz/grime combo of the big show, but they do have Screenshot Saturday, a lovely Twitter tag to share some peeks at in-progress work. This week: some lonely foxes, a handful of very helpful party decorations, and a wonderful collection of scrap.

notes.title: Songbird Symphony makes its debut on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, welcome to the Steam page of Songbird Symphony!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33432476/1bb120abf7c730261f91f4b69f4ce7953d9e1bd1.png[/img]

We hope you like cute bouncy animations and pixel art because we sure do! 

We're very happy to announce that the game will be launching on Steam next Spring. Meanwhile, don't forget to add us to your wishlist to get notified when the game is released. You can also support us on [url=http://patreon.com/joysteak]Patreon[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/cBqRT6C]Discord server[/url]. We hope to see you there soon!
